title: Will and Shall (Future) - Basic future with will

options.answer: I will go to the park tomorrow.
I will goes to the park tomorrow.
I will going to the park tomorrow.

explanation.en: The correct structure for the future simple with 'will' is 'will' + base form of the verb. 'Goes' and 'going' are incorrect forms after 'will'.
explanation.ru: Правильная структура для простого будущего времени с 'will' - это 'will' + начальная форма глагола. 'Goes' и 'going' - неправильные формы после 'will'.
explanation.uz: 'Will' bilan oddiy kelasi zamonning to'g'ri tuzilishi 'will' + fe'lning asosiy shaklidir. 'Goes' va 'going' 'will'dan keyin noto'g'ri shakllardir.

options.answer: He will not comes to the party.
He will not come to the party.
He will not came to the party.

explanation.en: After 'will not' (or 'won't'), you must use the base form of the verb. 'Comes' and 'came' are incorrect.
explanation.ru: После 'will not' (или 'won't') вы должны использовать начальную форму глагола. 'Comes' и 'came' неправильные.
explanation.uz: 'Will not' (yoki 'won't') dan keyin fe'lning asosiy shaklini ishlatishingiz kerak. 'Comes' va 'came' noto'g'ri.

options.answer: We will travels to Italy next year.
We will travel to Italy next year.
We traveling to Italy next year.

explanation.en: The simple future tense with 'will' requires the base form of the verb. 'Travels' is present simple and 'traveling' is a continuous form, both are incorrect here.
explanation.ru: Простое будущее время с 'will' fe'lning asosiy shaklini talab qiladi. 'Travels' hozirgi oddiy zamon, 'traveling' esa davomiy shakl bo'lib, ikkalasi ham bu yerda noto'g'ri.
explanation.uz: 'Will' bilan oddiy kelasi zamon 'will' + fe'lning asosiy shaklini talab qiladi. 'Travels' hozirgi oddiy zamon, 'traveling' esa davomiy shakl bo'lib, ikkalasi ham bu yerda noto'g'ri.

options.answer: She will be a doctor one day.
She will is a doctor one day.
She will are a doctor one day.

explanation.en: After 'will', we use the base form of the verb 'to be', which is 'be'. 'Is' and 'are' are not base forms.
explanation.ru: После 'will' biz 'to be' fe'lining asosiy shakli bo'lgan 'be' dan foydalanamiz. 'Is' va 'are' asosiy shakllar emas.
explanation.uz: 'Will' dan keyin 'to be' fe'lining asosiy shakli bo'lgan 'be' ishlatiladi. 'Is' va 'are' asosiy shakl emas.

options.answer: Will you help me with my homework?
Will you helps me with my homework?
Will you helped me with my homework?

explanation.en: In questions with 'will', the structure is 'Will' + subject + base form of the verb. 'Helps' and 'helped' are incorrect forms.
explanation.ru: 'Will' bilan savollarda tuzilish 'Will' + ega + fe'lning asosiy shakli. 'Helps' va 'helped' noto'g'ri shakllardir.
explanation.uz: 'Will' bilan savollarda tuzilish 'Will' + ega + fe'lning asosiy shaklidir. 'Helps' va 'helped' noto'g'ri shakllardir.

options.answer: The sun will shining soon.
The sun will shines soon.
The sun will shine soon.

explanation.en: The correct verb form after 'will' is the base form, 'shine'. 'Shining' and 'shines' are incorrect.
explanation.ru: 'Will' dan keyin fe'lning to'g'ri shakli asosiy shakli, ya'ni 'shine'. 'Shining' va 'shines' noto'g'ri.
explanation.uz: 'Will'dan keyin fe'lning to'g'ri shakli 'shine' asosiy shaklidir. 'Shining' va 'shines' noto'g'ri.

options.answer: They will not came to school tomorrow.
They will not comes to school tomorrow.
They will not come to school tomorrow.

explanation.en: For negative sentences with 'will', the structure is 'will not' + base form of the verb. 'Came' and 'comes' are incorrect.
explanation.ru: 'Will' bilan salbiy gaplar uchun tuzilish 'will not' + fe'lning asosiy shaklidir. 'Came' va 'comes' noto'g'ri.
explanation.uz: 'Will' bilan inkor gaplar uchun tuzilish 'will not' + fe'lning asosiy shaklidir. 'Came' va 'comes' noto'g'ri.

options.answer: What will you do tomorrow?
What will you doing tomorrow?
What you will do tomorrow?

explanation.en: Question structure with a wh-word is 'wh-word' + 'will' + subject + base form of the verb. 'Doing' is incorrect and 'you will' is the word order for a statement, not a question.
explanation.ru: Wh-so'z bilan savol tuzilishi 'wh-so'z' + 'will' + ega + fe'lning asosiy shaklidir. 'Doing' noto'g'ri va 'you will' gapning so'z tartibi, savolning emas.
explanation.uz: Wh-so'z bilan savol tuzilishi 'wh-so'z' + 'will' + ega + fe'lning asosiy shaklidir. 'Doing' noto'g'ri va 'you will' gapning so'z tartibi, savolning emas.

options.answer: They will to finish the project next week.
They will finish the project next week.
They will finished the project next week.

explanation.en: The correct form is 'will' + base form of the verb, without 'to'. 'Finished' is the past form and is incorrect here.
explanation.ru: To'g'ri shakl 'will' + fe'lning asosiy shakli, 'to'siz. 'Finished' o'tgan zamon shakli bo'lib, bu yerda noto'g'ri.
explanation.uz: To'g'ri shakl 'will' + fe'lning asosiy shaklidir, 'to'siz. 'Finished' o'tgan zamon shakli bo'lib, bu yerda noto'g'ri.

options.answer: I think it will rains tomorrow.
I think it will raining tomorrow.
I think it will rain tomorrow.

explanation.en: The verb form after 'will' must be the base form. 'Rains' and 'raining' are incorrect.
explanation.ru: 'Will' dan keyin fe'lning shakli asosiy shakl bo'lishi kerak. 'Rains' va 'raining' noto'g'ri.
explanation.uz: 'Will'dan keyin fe'lning shakli asosiy shakl bo'lishi kerak. 'Rains' va 'raining' noto'g'ri.
